basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I have a penchant for retro games and spend my free time tinkering with video game mods or learning new programming languages. I dislike toxic gaming communities and always strive for fair play. Typically online in the evenings after work, as I am a software developer by day. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science from the University of Toronto, I’ve always been drawn to technology and gaming. My knowledge in these areas has been further enriched by self-teaching through online courses and active participation in gaming and tech forums.
